text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
For Papa, for Mama... and I can give 
presents to my jiejies too!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
If Dad's business prospers even more 
because of this... it'll all be thanks to 
you!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I bet you'll be honored for your 
contributions, so start thinking of an 
acceptance speech, okay?♪
